pick.name: Drizzle ORM + drizzle-kit
pick.why: Same ORM on server Postgres AND on-device SQLite (expo-sqlite, op-sqlite, Electron libsql/better-sqlite3, PGlite) - key for one-stack; no engine binary
pick.install: npm i drizzle-orm && npm i -D drizzle-kit

candidates.name: Drizzle (pick)
candidates.verdict: One schema for server + device DBs.

candidates.name: Prisma 7/8
candidates.verdict: Prisma 8 is a full TS rewrite still in RC (npm 'latest' tag points at an RC - pin 7.x until 8 GA). Wins for schema-first DX.

candidates.name: Kysely
candidates.verdict: Wins if you prefer plain typed SQL and own migrations.

decision: Drizzle is the only popular TS ORM that runs the same schema on Postgres and on Expo/Electron SQLite, which matters for offline-capable apps. Flip to Prisma once 8.0 is GA if schema-first migrations matter more than on-device use.
details: Drizzle core team joined PlanetScale (announced 2026-03-03, project stays independent OSS). Still 0.x; v1 in RC since May 2026 - pin versions.

verify.note: Drizzle joining PlanetScale confirmed on PlanetScale blog dated 2026-03-03: 'Drizzle will remain an independent open source project with its own roadmap'; Drizzle's sustainability page says PlanetScale hired the entire core team.
